title: Space Tech Briefing — September 06, 2026
summary:
Good morning, space enthusiasts! This is your daily dose of the cosmos, live on September 06, 2026. What an incredible 24 hours it's been in the world of space – we have groundbreaking news straight from Europe!

Let's dive right in! Yesterday, September 5th, 2026, German company Isar Aerospace officially etched its name into the history books. They've become the FIRST European commercial company to successfully achieve orbital flight! Their Spectrum launcher lifted off flawlessly from the Andøya Space Centre in Norway at precisely 10:12 PM CEST. It was a perfect launch, successfully deploying its payloads into low-Earth orbit. This is a monumental achievement, folks, a true game-changer for European private space initiatives and a massive leap forward for commercial space access. Congratulations, Isar Aerospace!

And now, for something that brings the wonder of space right into our living rooms. The French space agency, CNES, has just released its top five must-watch space series! Since *Star Trek* first captivated audiences in 1966, shows about space have continued to fascinate. CNES highlights how series like *The Expanse* and *For All Mankind* brilliantly echo the challenges and ambitions of our current space conquest. If you're looking for your next captivating binge-watch that truly connects with real-world space exploration, CNES has some fantastic recommendations for you!

What a day for space, from groundbreaking launches to captivating storytelling! We'll be back tomorrow with more updates from across the galaxy. Until then, keep looking up, and have a stellar day!
